# code402

> Pay-per-call deterministic tools for autonomous agents, settled via x402
> (HTTP 402) in USDC. Every paid call returns a signed secp256k1 receipt binding
> input hash, output hash, tool version, and timestamp — third-party verifiable.

OPERATOR: code402.dev is operated by JUANA LIMITED, Company No. 14043409,
registered in England & Wales. Registered office: Unit 7, Edison Building,
Coventry, CV1 4JA, United Kingdom. Security contact: security@code402.dev.

ENVIRONMENT: production. Endpoint https://code402.dev — Base mainnet
(chain 8453), real USDC. Staging for integration testing:
https://code402-edge.akrivis.workers.dev — Base Sepolia testnet
(chain 84532), test USDC. The 402 challenge body is always authoritative
for recipient, amount, chain, and nonce.

## How to call (agent quickstart)

- No accounts, no API keys. Payment is the credential.
- POST /v1/tools/{tool}/call unpaid → HTTP 402 challenge with price, recipient,
  nonce, expiry.
- Sign an EIP-3009 TransferWithAuthorization (EIP-712 typed data) for the
  challenge amount, retry the identical request with header
  X-PAYMENT: {"auth":{...},"signature":[...65 bytes]} → HTTP 200.
- Response headers carry X-Schema-Version. Response schemas are frozen per
  version; breaking changes only ever ship under a new schema version.
- Idempotency: pass idempotency_key; a repeated key returns
  {idempotent_replay:true, receipt_ref} and is never double-charged.

openapi.body:
openapi: 3.1.0
info:
  title: code402 Deterministic Tools API
  version: 1.0.0
  description: >-
    Pay-per-call deterministic tools for autonomous agents, settled via x402
    (HTTP 402) in USDC. Call unpaid to receive a 402 challenge; pay via an
    EIP-3009 TransferWithAuthorization; retry with the X-PAYMENT header to
    receive the deterministic output plus a signed secp256k1 receipt binding
    input hash, output hash, tool version, and timestamp. All tools are
    strictly deterministic: identical input yields byte-identical output per
    tool version. Response schemas are frozen per X-Schema-Version; breaking
    changes ship only under a new schema version.
  x-environment: production (Base mainnet, chain 8453, USDC)
servers:
  - url: https://code402.dev
    description: production (Base mainnet, USDC)
  - url: https://code402-edge.akrivis.workers.dev
    description: staging (Base Sepolia, test USDC)
paths:
  /v1/tools/{tool}/call:
    post:
      summary: Pay-per-call deterministic tool execution
      description: >-
        Executes a deterministic, machine-verifiable tool. Without payment,
        returns a 402 challenge containing price, recipient, nonce, and expiry.
        With a valid X-PAYMENT voucher, returns the tool output and a signed
        receipt. Pass idempotency_key to make retries safe: a repeated key
        returns idempotent_replay:true with the original receipt reference and
        is never double-charged.
      parameters:
        - name: tool
          in: path
          required: true
          description: Tool identifier.
          schema:
            type: string
            enum: [vat-mod97-check, company-number-format, context-distill, iban-check, lei-check, isin-check, luhn-check, swift-bic-check, ean13-check, gstin-check]
      requestBody:
        required: true
        content:
          application/json:
